// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// The permitted read of a counter table: findMany with an explicit column list
// and no relation, summed in process. This is why MailCounter is OPS_OWNED
// rather than AGGREGATE_ONLY, which permits only count and groupBy and can sum
// no tally column at all.
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function windowTotals(fromDay: string) {
  return db.mailCounter.findMany({
    where: { day: { gte: fromDay } },
    select: { day: true, templateKey: true, outcome: true, statusClass: true, count: true },
  });
}
